# 1 Chronicles 4 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 4 (43 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.10 — Final clause of Jabez's prayer
- **EMET:** "so-as-not to-grieve-me" / **LOGOS:** "so that it might not grieve me" / **PNEUMA:** "so that I will be free from pain"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "so that it might not bring me pain" — middle path preserving the name-pain wordplay.

---

## V.4 — "father of" as founder
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "the father of Bethlehem" / **PNEUMA:** "who founded Bethlehem"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the father of Bethlehem" — consistent with ch.2 ruling on this genealogical idiom.

---

## V.22 — "the records are ancient"
- **EMET:** literal with brackets / **LOGOS:** "(The records are ancient.)" / **PNEUMA:** "(These records are very old.)"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "(The records are ancient.)" — parenthetical; "ancient" closer to *atiqim*.

---

## V.38 — "broke forth" vs. "increased greatly"
- **EMET:** "broke-forth to-a-multitude" / **LOGOS/SOPHIA:** "increased greatly" / **PNEUMA:** "grew so large"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "increased greatly" — clarity over imagery.

---
*— SOPHIA*
